content.short: Planet IX is the biggest GameFi platform on the entire Polygon blockchain.
content.description: Planet IX is a DeFi and NFT strategy game set in a sci‑fi universe. Players farm resources, build and trade NFT assets, choose their strategy, and stake game rewards to earn yields. Since launching on-chain in 2021, Planet IX has attracted a dedicated player base with 550k+ unique players and more than 400 million NFTs sold. The $IXT token powers the ecosystem, with 230,000+ holders and more than 60% of the token locked in staking via Ix.Foundation. The aim of $IXT and Planet IX is to onboard the next one million users onto its expanding platform.
